verdict.rationale: Atlassian's feature page claims "Rich APIs", and independent community reports confirm hands-on REST use: developers write Jira API wrapper scripts for filing bugs and run JQL queries over REST. The core of programmatic control is therefore corroborated. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt at the guessed developer.atlassian.com paths, which leaves the documentation side thinly evidenced but does not contradict that the API exists. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party API reference documentation in the pack, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable path, documentation of auth and coverage of operations.
